## Accepted partial results, attempt 1/5

Problem 11000037 / AMR-109-0037, rank 1254. The arbitrary-generating-set Torelli density conjecture remains unresolved. No novelty or exhaustive continuing-openness certification is claimed.

The complete report proves exponential Torelli negligibility after an explicit generating-set enlargement containing any prescribed finite subset. It includes the tree adjacency estimate, quotient spectral decomposition, labelled-word upper bound, distinct-element lower bound and homological free-subgroup construction. The authored F_3 x F_2 example refutes a general generating-set transfer, without being a mapping-class-group counterexample.

The separate logarithmic appendix proves a liminf of at least 1/2 for every finite symmetric generating set, and proves that both infima over generating sets, for logarithmic liminf and limsup, equal 1/2, even with any fixed finite subset prescribed. It supplies the conjugacy-fiber and centralizer-growth arguments. No fixed-set logarithmic limit existence, infimum attainment or arbitrary-set ordinary density conclusion is claimed. Closed oriented genus g>=2 and the harmless identity-generator convention remain explicit.

## Publication and review boundary

Only seven proof/audit/status and public-source-metadata files are added under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/11000037/`. All mathematical arguments, qualifications and authored symbolic examples remain. Programs, computational sections and results, checkers, certificates, fixtures, datasets, copied scholarly source bodies, images and private coordination/version identities are excluded. No excluded computation is rewritten as prose.

This is an AI-assisted, unrefereed proof-and-audit edition. Scoped acceptance is not external human peer review, journal acceptance or formal proof-assistant certification. The public citations retain their actual scope: McCarthy's centralizer theorem was checked through author-hosted text and abstract, with no local PDF identity, visual inspection or new proof audit claimed. The failed direct retrieval and unavailable screenshot pixels remain disclosed. Historical source inspection and bounded literature searches are not presented as fresh edition-preparation checks.

QUEUE.md and unrelated entries are unchanged. Editorial preparation adds no substantive proof turn and does not reset partial attempt 1/5. No merge, release, DOI or outside outreach is requested.
